tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with normal red cell indices, suggesting possible early or mild normocytic anemia. Platelet count is at the upper normal limit, but platelet distribution width is elevated, which may indicate increased platelet activation or variability. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are within normal limits. Further clinical correlation and possibly iron studies are recommended.
